title: docs: README says SSO is free; ROADMAP.md becomes a short North Star summary
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HPCiLqQ2HSnXR9Jz2eBoFXGK)_

Refs objectstack-ai/cloud#3844, objectstack-ai/cloud#3834 (README row), objectstack-ai/cloud#3835 (item 2)

## What changes

- **`README.md` (You own it, lines 195–196):** single sign-on (OIDC / SAML) is part of what this repository ships, free. "multi-environment operations" is dropped from what ObjectOS Cloud and Enterprise add: Cloud now has one environment per organization, and the dev environment type was retired.
- **`ROADMAP.md`:** the 2026-06-06 file (stale documentation chores and an outdated architecture list) becomes a short public summary:
  - names the *Features on the road* table in `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` as the source of truth, and says the North Star wins where they differ;
  - distils **Now / Next / Later** from the road's steps, in the table's order: Now = set out, run it locally, verify; Next = publish and install, connect an agent; Later = iterate on a customer request. It says the weekly walk, not this page, decides which step is P0;
  - one line pointing to objectos.ai for the commercial editions' roadmap;
  - keeps the "where the details live" pointers (issues, milestones, CHANGELOGs, platform checklist, ADRs, `ui/`).
  - It has no Enterprise content.

## Why

cloud#3834: the README still told readers SSO was a Cloud / Enterprise add-on, and named multi-environment operations that no longer exist. cloud#3835 item 2: the open-source ROADMAP.md should be a North Star summary, and Enterprise roadmap content does not belong in this repository.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs`: 952 internal fragment links resolve.
- `node scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs`: clean.
- `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`: no citations added.
- Every relative link in the new ROADMAP.md points at an existing path (`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`, `docs/adr`, `ui/docs/adr`, `ui/CHANGELOG.md`). The README's T1–T4 lines (7–31), which www.objectos.ai quotes, are untouched.
- Neither file is a governed surface. The diff publishes nothing, so it needs the `skip-changeset` label rather than a changeset.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Markdown only)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
